status: Completed first1000 numerical, native, analytic and real-camera review; continue original schedule without promotion.
decision: Continue V58 on its original10000 schedule without promotion. Mixed early photo/real scores and weak-detail loss do not establish an improvement, but first1000 is insufficient for a convergence judgment. Preserve V43 README reference and frozen data/source.

plan.scope: Fresh Gaussian initialization, seed48/B16/original10000 schedule, first1000 gate. Same Commons40170/native128/paired32 and physical/augmentation policy. Genuine frozen DINOv3 ConvNeXt-Tiny plus multiscale fusion replaces absent/ViT context: backbone, fusion and capacity differ jointly. Recompute original3 first1000 neural controls and all baselines; full427/paired/weak-flat/fullGFX/three additional cached cameras. One seed/early gate does not establish convergence, SOTA or promotion. Manual crop review follows automated evaluation.

result.scope: Integrity of120 native PNGs,35 unquantized context arrays and12 fullRGB16 TIFFs. Manual visual review and quality decision are separate.
Independent saved-score coverage and arithmetic audit only; no inference, pixel/GT-definition validation, speed result, training-repeat uncertainty or model selection.
result.resampling: 1000 paired source/scene bootstrap resamples, seed42, percentile95 interval; matches current declared procedure.

result.scope: Complete first1000 saved state and old-control metric replay; not the final native/real review.

boundary.scope: Complete-state/batch boundary audit only; no convergence or quality decision.

result.scope: Completed paired artifacts and case replay only; full-photo/analytic/real evaluation and manual review remain separate.

analytic.limitations: Known horizontal carriers are an artificial task; false-band/peak metrics quantify residual energy, not a complete hallucination detector. GPU FP16 results are not exact replay of earlier CPU FP32 neural scores. Full photo/real/GFX review remains required.

selection.notes: GFX100S / 55mm. Noisy DSCF3879: ISO6400, f/1.7, 1/240s, 17:13:27. Reference DSCF3880: ISO100, f/5.6, 3s, 17:17:05. Captured 3m38s apart with nearly identical framing. Aperture, depth of field, clouds, lights and moving subjects still differ. Native sensor crops with input/reference-only integer coordinate matching; no resizing or warping, no per-panel brightness adjustment. Qualitative reference, not exact ground truth; evaluation-only, never training.

native_visual_review.decision: Continue V58 on its original10000 schedule without promotion. Mixed early photo/real scores and weak-detail loss do not establish an improvement, but first1000 is insufficient for a convergence judgment. Preserve V43 README reference and frozen data/source.

notes_by_panel.paired: All4 learned methods remove strong grain but soften plates/wavy highlights versus independently AHD reference. Panel boundaries and tiny bright points retained. RawNIND lines are softer and 7D boundary fringes stronger. Unseen apples/Coulicoco regions look broadly similar; soft low-contrast structure remains. No decisive native detail gain by V58 on these four displayed cases. Low-noise AHD reference is not exact RGB GT.
notes_by_panel.two-source: All4 learned models remove grain but lose the fine fabric cords. No gross late10k-style color shift appears at this first1000 crop; V58 fabric color looks close to the others, with similarly smooth texture. V58 building edges clean, cloud texture softened; no decisive fine-detail gain over no-context/S/B. Both RawNIND variants have softer/color-fringed building outlines. Synthetic GT exact for these generated observations.
notes_by_panel.analytic: Dark carrier almost removed in all4 models. Brighter weak carrier has faint residual broad bands, strongly attenuated relative to analytic GT; V58/none retain slightly more measured carrier gain than S/B but none approaches true amplitude. Neutral flats look clean with mild residual low-frequency variation; this does not rule out other false detail or color failures.
notes_by_panel.gfx: All4 learned models remove strong grain and retain more continuous fence strands than both RawNIND variants. Sky smooth; building bracket/truss and fine foliage remain softened. V58 foliage/fence broadly similar to the other learned methods, without a decisive detail gain. RawNIND foliage blotchier and mesh crossings less separated. ISO100 f/5.6 aperture/time/motion differences limit reference interpretation.
notes_by_panel.three-camera: All4 learned models have similar soft Q2 rock/shadow structure and Sony wall/windows. Some low-contrast texture is smoothed; neither method is a clean reference. GFX50R concrete seams are sharper than both RawNIND variants, with stronger residual/coherent surface variation that cannot be assigned to true detail without GT. No decisive V58 improvement across the3 cameras or broad real-quality claim.

limitations: One seed/early gate, original nondeterministic CUDA policy; source intervals do not quantify training repeatability. Backbone, fusion and projection capacity change jointly. No convergence, SOTA, broad real-quality or ten-second claim; protected-final scoring remains closed.
